Hi Ellen / Rajiv —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce inference unit cost for your customer-facing summarization pipeline while keeping 95th-percentile latency under 150ms.
- Current infra: on-prem GPU pool + burst to cloud; throughput varies heavily during EMEA peak.
- Risk: internal compliance requires detailed audit logs and tenant isolation for PII.

Who should attend the technical deep dive: your platform lead (Tom), and one of your infra engineers. On our side I recommend Marissa (solutions engineer) and me.

Proposed next step: a focused technical deep dive to walk through a proof-of-concept plan and latency/cost profile. I tentatively suggested Oct 20 for the demo in our notes but understand your team has calendar pressure. Attached are the discovery notes and a short proposed agenda.

Can you lock one of these two tight options (we're keeping both reserved for 48 hours):
1) Tue Oct 20 — 10:00–10:45 PDT (connor / marissa)
2) Thu Oct 22 — 14:00–14:45 PDT (connor / marissa / stephanie)

Please reply with "1" or "2" or let me know if we need a different window — if I don't hear back by end of day Tuesday I'll release the slots to other customers.

Thanks,

Connor O'Brien
